title: Eddie Shields and Sidney Lanfield fail to fit the band
summary: He describes trying out Eddie Shields and Sidney Lanfield before the London trip.

story.theme_name: Getting paid: wages, tips and leaving over money
story.community_name: Quitting the band: why sidemen left

blocks.x: Eddie Shields. Eddie Shields. Eddie Shields. Harry's a clarinet. Yeah. Eddie Shields. Eddie Shields. He was older than Harry. And he came on up there and he couldn't fit into the rhythm. We kept him two weeks to make enough money to go back home. We tried on every song platter. We wouldn't go to London England. I had already signed a contract with the Morris Agency. We'd go to London to open the Joy Bells Theater. And out of a clear sky after trying to bounce, you know, I had Sidney Lansfield sit in the band. Today he's a big movie executive. Now you know I'm not going to say this because that man could sue me, but he played with me two weeks and he couldn't make the grades. Sidney Lansfield. He's out in Hollywood somewhere. He's a big movie magnet today.
